command: import {DatabaseSync,backup} from 'node:sqlite';import {mkdirSync,copyFileSync,chmodSync} from 'node:fs';let result;try{const db=new DatabaseSync('/data/bookings.sqlite',{readOnly:true});const active=db.prepare("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM bookings WHERE status IN ('checkout','processing','payment_review','refund_pending')").get().n;if(active)throw Error('Active payment operation');const dir='/backup/evening-20261011';mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});await backup(db,dir+'/bookings.sqlite');copyFileSync('/data/master.key',dir+'/master.key');chmodSync(dir+'/bookings.sqlite',0o600);chmodSync(dir+'/master.key',0o600);const c=new DatabaseSync(dir+'/bookings.sqlite',{readOnly:true});if(c.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check').get().integrity_check!=='ok')throw Error('Integrity failed');result={backupVerified:true,integrity:'ok',activePayments:active,bookings:c.prepare('SELECT count(*) AS n FROM bookings').get().n};c.close();db.close();}catch(e){result={backupVerified:false,error:e.message};}console.log(JSON.stringify(result));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600000));
